subject: POC observability: proposed checkpoints, owners & next steps
messages:
From: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
To: Helen Park <hpark@finova.ai>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 09 Jul 2028 09:15:00 -0700
Subject: POC observability: proposed checkpoints, owners & next steps

Hi Helen —

Thanks again for the call this morning. Quick recap and a suggested POC plan focused on observability so your SRE/Platform team can validate performance and cost before a wider rollout. Please review and confirm or flag changes.

POC goals (2-week sandbox):
- Verify latency (p95) under expected traffic profile: target < 300ms end-to-end for inference path.
- Validate reliability: request_error_rate < 0.1% over sustained runs.
- Measure unit economics: token cost per 1k tokens under $0.60 (approx.).
- Functional coverage: >=95% pass rate on your top-10 intents test set.

Observability scope / deliverables:
- Dashboards: latency p50/p95/p99, request rate, tokens per request, model variant usage, KV cache hit rate, batching stats.
- Tracing: distributed traces for request paths (sampling configurable, default 10%). We'll provide Jaeger-compatible traces exported to your collector.
- Logs: structured request logs (JSON) exported to S3 or your Splunk instance; default retention 90 days unless you specify.
- Alerts: simple SLO alert rules (p95 latency breach, error-rate increase, token-cost spike).
- Data access: token-level accounting for cost attribution (per-client app id).

Owners (proposed):
- Monica Patel (Redwood) — overall POC coordination, billing/questions.
- Karthik Iyer (Redwood, Solutions) — instrumentation, dashboard templates, run the smoke tests.
- Laura Bennett (Redwood, CS) — onboarding, test dataset ingestion, run acceptance checklist.
- Finova data-platform (Helen) — provide dev account access, test traffic, acceptance signoff.

Timeline (proposed):
- Day 0: Kickoff + access exchange (IAM role + service account).
- Day 1–3: Instrumentation & dashboard deployment (Redwood templates).
- Day 4–7: Load runs + trace collection + iterate on sampling.
- Day 8–10: Validation against Finova testsets; cost analysis.
- Day 11–14: Acceptance, handover notes, and optional canary plan.

Immediate next steps for Helen:
1) Confirm dev account region (us-west-2) and where you want logs delivered (S3 bucket or Splunk).
2) Share a short list of the top-10 intents + test dataset link (drive or S3).
3) Sign the trial MSA (I attached a one-page summary).

Attachments: POC_plan_v1.pdf (high-level plan), dashboard_template.json, metric-specs.md.

If this looks good I’ll schedule a 30-min kickoff for Wed 11am PT.

Thanks,
Monica
Monica Patel | Enterprise Sales, Redwood Inference
monica.patel@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0183
Redwood Inference — Developer-first inference for production
From: Helen Park <hpark@finova.ai>
To: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
Cc: Finova Data Platform Team <data-platform@finova.ai>
Date: Mon, 09 Jul 2028 11:02:13 -0700
Subject: Re: POC observability: proposed checkpoints, owners & next steps

Thanks for the thorough recap, Monica — this is very helpful. A few quick clarifications from our side:

- Retention & compliance: 90 days on logs is fine, but can you confirm logs are encrypted at rest and we can provide our own KMS key?
- SOC2 / security: can you share the SOC2 report and the dataflow diagram (we’ll need both for procurement)?
- Sampling: our ML infra prefers 1% default trace sampling but we can ramp to 10% for short runs. Can Redwood change that dynamically?
- Cost: can you confirm the trial account will not incur charges to Finova — Redwood covers the sandbox costs up to the trial limits?

We can provide the top-10 intents and a sanitized test set via our internal S3. Region = us-west-2; we prefer logs to go to a Finova S3 bucket (will provide IAM role).

Please schedule kickoff Wed at 11am PT and loop in anyone from your infra team who will be touching IAM/trace config.

—
Helen Park
Head of ML Platforms | Finova
hpark@finova.ai | +1 212-555-0147
From: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
To: Helen Park <hpark@finova.ai>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 09 Jul 2028 15:30:00 -0700
Subject: Re: POC observability: proposed checkpoints, owners & next steps

Helen — thanks, notes below inline.

- Encryption/KMS: yes — we support customer-managed KMS keys for S3 export. We’ll request the ARN during kickoff and configure the export role.
- SOC2: attached link (Redwood_SOC2_summary.pdf) in the related links; we’ll share the full report under an NDA if needed.
- Trace sampling: configurable on the per-deployment policy; we can set 1% default and have a scripted toggle to 10% during load runs. Karthik will own the toggle.
- Trial billing: Redwood will absorb sandbox infra costs for the 2-week trial up to the agreed token cap in the POC_plan_v1 (we included an estimate). Any usage beyond the cap will be flagged and requires pre-approval.

We’ll plan the kickoff for Wed Jul 11 at 11:00am PT — invite to follow. I’ve also attached the dashboard template and metric-specs for your infra team to glance at before kickoff.

Thanks — looking forward to getting started.

Best,
Monica

Team — following Helen’s confirmation and the kickoff scheduled for Wed 11am PT, please find concrete actions and owners. I’ll update this thread as items close.

Immediate tasks (owner — due):
- Create dashboard template in Grafana and attach to Finova dev account (Karthik) — due Wed EOD. Attachment: dashboard_template.json
- Prepare metric ingestion spec and JSON schema for request logs -> S3 (Neha) — due Wed noon. Attachment: metric-specs.md
- Prepare step-by-step IAM role instructions for Finova to attach (Laura) — due Tue EOD.
- Create a short runbook for toggling trace sampling 1% -> 10% (Karthik) — due Thu AM.
- Prepare acceptance checklist (pass/fail criteria for top-10 intents) and a test harness invocation script (Laura) — due Fri.

Notes on instrumentation: keep batching metrics broken out (batch_size histogram), expose per-client token_count, and add a tag for model_variant so Finova can compare quantized vs FP16 runs.

Please reply with quick ACK and any capacity conflicts.

Thanks,
Monica
